description: Complete model-facing ZenoBench Skill Library. Each task-level skill has one authoritative source contract under skills/.

types.ArticulatedPart: name of an annotated door, drawer, or appliance door in the current scene
types.MovableObject: name of an annotated movable object in the current scene
types.ContainerObject: name of an annotated movable object with a container profile
types.SupportSurface: name or resolved alias of an annotated support surface
types.Microwave: name of an annotated microwave with the required controls

skills.name: Navigate the robot to a target pose
skills.description: Move the mobile robot to a specified planar pose, including while carrying an object.
requires: A target pose is specified in the current scene.
A collision-free base route and a safe arm posture are available at execution time.
achieves: The robot reaches the target pose.

outcomes.success: The robot arrives at the requested pose; a carried object remains held.
outcomes.failure: No route or safe arm posture is found, or the carried object is dropped.

skills.name: Open a door or drawer
skills.description: Open an annotated articulated door or drawer so its interior can be accessed.
requires: The named part has an annotated handle and open joint target.
The gripper is free for handle manipulation.
A collision-free pose for reaching and moving the handle can be found at execution time.

outcomes.success: The part reaches its annotated open joint target within the skill's tolerance.
outcomes.failure: The handle cannot be reached or grasped, or the part does not reach the open target.

skills.name: Close a door or drawer
skills.description: Close an annotated articulated door or drawer after access or to satisfy a closed-state goal.
requires: The named part has an annotated handle and closed joint target.
The gripper is free for handle manipulation.
A collision-free pose for reaching and moving the handle can be found at execution time.

outcomes.success: The part reaches its annotated closed joint target within the skill's tolerance.
outcomes.failure: The handle cannot be reached or grasped, or the part does not reach the closed target.

skills.name: Pick up an object
skills.description: Grasp and lift an annotated movable object. The skill selects an available grasp strategy internally, including an edge grasp for suitable flat objects.
requires: The gripper is empty.
The object exists in the current scene and has a feasible grasp annotation.
Any door or drawer blocking access to the object is open.
A reachable grasp can be found at execution time.
achieves: The robot holds the specified object.

outcomes.success: The specified object is held after lifting.
outcomes.failure: No feasible grasp or approach is found, or the object slips from the gripper.

skills.name: Push an object along its support
skills.description: Move an object horizontally across the annotated surface beneath it by a requested displacement.
requires: The gripper is free to make contact with the object.
The object rests on an annotated support surface.
The requested displacement has nonzero length.
A reachable push or drag approach can be found at execution time.
achieves: The object moves in the requested direction along its support.

outcomes.success: The object has measurably moved in the requested direction.
outcomes.failure: No approach is reachable, or the object does not move sufficiently.

skills.name: Place a held object inside a container
skills.description: Release a held object into an annotated container.
requires: The robot holds the specified object.
The container exists in the current scene and has a container annotation.
The container opening is accessible and a placement pose is reachable at execution time.
achieves: The specified object is inside the container.

outcomes.success: The object is released and measured inside the container.
outcomes.failure: The placement pose cannot be reached, or the released object is not inside the container.

skills.name: Place a held object on a surface
skills.description: Find a free spot on an annotated support surface and place a held object there.
requires: The robot holds the specified object.
The support exists in the current scene.
A free and reachable placement spot is available at execution time.
Any door or drawer blocking the target surface is open.
achieves: The specified object is on the support.

outcomes.success: The released object is measured on the support.
outcomes.failure: No free reachable spot is found, or the released object is not on the support.

skills.name: Start heating food in a microwave
skills.description: Press the annotated microwave start button to begin heating food already inside its cavity.
requires: The microwave has annotated controls and a configured thermal task state.
The microwave door is closed.
At least one configured food object is inside the microwave cavity.
The start button is reachable at execution time.

outcomes.success: The start button is reached and the thermal task state becomes active.
outcomes.failure: The door is open, no configured food is inside, or the button cannot be reached.

skills.name: Open and reclose a microwave door for inspection
skills.description: Press the annotated microwave door control, open the powered door for inspection, and close it again.
requires: The microwave has an annotated door button and powered hinge.
The microwave door starts closed.
The door button and inspection pose are reachable at execution time.
achieves: The microwave door has been opened and returned to the closed state.

outcomes.success: The powered door reaches its open target and then its closed target.
outcomes.failure: The button cannot be reached, or the powered door misses either target.

connections.when: Explicit repositioning is useful. Manipulation skills may navigate internally, so this edge is optional.
The chosen object is behind the opened door or drawer.
The target surface is inside the opened appliance or furniture.
Access is finished and the same part should be closed.
The part is the microwave door and configured food is inside the cavity.
The picked object is the object to put inside the container.
The picked object is the object to put on the surface.

An independently requested push creates a graspable position for the same object, confirmed by observation. Do not add this step solely for a flat object; pick already handles its own edge-push strategy.
The object was placed behind the same opened door and the door must be closed.
The prepared food is already in the microwave and the inspection door cycle has finished.
